page.overview:
Who is Greg?

Greg is the protagonist in Fetch, the first story in the book of the same name. He is a nerdy teenage boy who hopes to use controversial science in order to control the world around him and get what he wants, which leads him to discovering an animatronic that seems to align with his goals.

Greg has a long face, eyes that are close together, and a small nose. He has long, wavy blond hair, average height, muscular arms and legs, and a “great smile”. Despite his muscles, Greg has narrow shoulders and a thin torso with a slight chest.

Greg is very nerdy and loves all forms of science, his passion earning him the title of teacher’s pet. He doesn’t like stereotypical masculine things like cars and sports, causing strife between him and his father. Greg desires more control in his life and plans to manipulate the Zero Point Field in order to get whatever he wants. Greg's endeavors in controlling the field has led him to become egotistical and somewhat controlling over his friends, persistently begging them into joining him in his experiments while also hiding his true intentions from them.

Greg grew up with a decently successful family. His father, a contractor, worked for long periods of time in order to afford big houses and expensive cars. Greg's uncle Darrin, however, was a wealthy, successful inventor of car parts and had amazing luck with investments and money in general. While Greg's father hates Dare, Greg loves him. When Greg was about four years old, he began to cry over a stuffed octopus in a claw machine he was unable to get. Dare tapped the glass of the machine with his right index finger and told Greg in a deep voice that he had "the Magic Finger of Luck." Dare managed to get the octopus first try, starting an ongoing joke that almost always worked.
